entities.name: Raymond Saw Po Ray
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Raymond Saw Po Ray was a Burmese Roman Catholic prelate. He was auxiliary bishop of Yangon (1987–1993) and bishop of Mawlamyine (1993–2023). Saw Po Ray died on 6 January 2025, at the age of 76.
